# Keep the Semgrep toolchain on the patched MCP SDK release; the scanner's
# dependency resolver otherwise selects an affected session implementation.
mcp==1.30.0
# Keep the scanner's OpenTelemetry packages on one patched, compatible release
# set. Updating only opentelemetry-api breaks Semgrep's pinned OTLP exporter.
opentelemetry-api==1.45.1
opentelemetry-sdk==1.45.1
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common==1.45.1
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.45.1
opentelemetry-proto==1.45.1
